free_tier.stated: Per-user quotas for account holders: Home 50 GB, Work 2 TB (not purged), Scratch 30 TB and 10 million files (purged after 180 days). Campaign Storage has no default quota and is allocated per project on request.

retention.stated: Scratch is purged after 180 days; Work is not purged; Campaign Storage is medium-term, typically three to five years.

tooling: Globus web and command-line transfers to the NSF NCAR Campaign Storage collection; /glade paths on the Derecho and Casper clusters

limits.value: Scratch 30 TB per user, purged after 180 days
Campaign Storage only by project allocation request
